messages:
nina: Heads up — customers hitting SCIM 500s after KMS alias switch during maintenance. Seeing KMS Decrypt errors in provisioner logs.

drew: Which alias was swapped? Any log snippet?

nina: alias/redwood-scim rotated at 03:05 UTC. Log: 
```
2026-03-25T03:07:11Z ERROR provisioner.worker tenant=zephyr KMSDecryptError: InvalidCiphertextException
2026-03-25T03:07:11Z WARN scim.queue id=xyz attempt=1 error=500
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: alias rotation completed by infra-ops at 2026-03-25T03:05:02Z (chg f1b2).

olga: Did the rotation include a rewrap/migrate-old-blobs phase? Our flow stores KMS-wrapped envelope keys; rewrap must finish before alias update.

kai: Two obvious failures: rewrap didn't run or rotator lacked kms:ReEncrypt perms. Check rotator cron and IAM logs.

nina: Rewrap cron shows earlier failure: AccessDenied for principal svc-account:provisioner-rotator. Looks like rewrap never finished.

drew: Fast remediation: point alias back to old key. Is old key still Enabled?

olga: Old key is Enabled. Rollback will restore decrypt for wrapped blobs. Watch for partial SCIM state changes — we'll need a reconcile run.

infa-bot: (noop)

infra-bot: deploy-bot: alias update queued (rollback f1b2-rollback).

nina: Rolled alias back at 03:13 UTC. Retries processing resumed for most tenants, but ~30 tenants showing deprov_pending with no external ID in IdP.

kai: That matches a mid-transaction failure. Run reconciliation over window 03:00-03:20 and collect affected tenant ids.

drew: Also update rotator IAM: need kms:Decrypt on old CMK and kms:Encrypt on new CMK and kms:ReEncrypt* if policy requires. Add DescribeKey.

olga: Update runbook: require rewrap_status=complete + sample decrypt checks (canary tenant) before alias swap. Add snapshot of scim_audit/scim_envelopes pre-swap.

nina: I'll run reconcile and open an infra ticket to patch rotator role. Will post incident summary and affected tenant list when done. :thumbsup:
